title: Assembly Fault Finder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Read six causes of faults on an SO-ARM101, each with what it looks like and what to check first. Then read eight symptoms and choose the most likely cause of each. Used in Chapter 8.

educational.topic: Troubleshooting an assembled arm: matching a symptom to its most likely cause
learningObjectives: Differentiate six causes of SO-ARM101 faults from eight written symptoms, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Pick out the one distinguishing clue in each symptom and match it to a cause, with the reason shown after each choice
keyQuestions: When does the fault appear: always, in one pose, or after some time?
What did the measurement read, and which cause does that point to?
commonMisconceptions: A servo that does not answer is broken
A joint that goes limp is faulty
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed choices from six causes, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery; the final screen lists the causes that were missed

controls.label: a / b / c / d / e / f (the six causes)
